title: Audio capture: microphone on both systems, call audio on Windows, Mac microphone permission check
summary: Grillo can record the room microphone on Windows and Mac and the call audio on Windows as 5-second 16 kHz mono slices sent to the main process, with a microphone permission check and device choice; nothing on screen yet.

deferred.what: window.grillo has no type in renderer code because tsc ignores src/preload/index.d.ts beside src/preload/index.ts; the app shell story re-declared it in src/renderer/main.ts, so two declarations must now be kept in step and every screen story meets this
deferred.why: Outside the seams of the audio capture and app shell stories

deferred.what: Nothing listens for a media track ending: if the picked microphone is unplugged or Windows ends the call-audio share mid-capture, capture stays running, only silence arrives and no error reaches anyone, so a meeting loses its audio while the screen says it is recording
deferred.why: Needs a mid-capture event channel to the session, a design choice for the grilling session story (issue #84), whose seam is the main-process session folder
